overall_notes: P2 recheck only: no injury or lineup changes undermine L1–L5, and nothing finished yet. I mirror the morning keeps on those legs with modest confidence where pricing is single-book, cross-book, or stale. L6 fails the post-mortem 3PM U1.5 ban and remains single-book with elevated recent 3PA/minutes—cut as a panel veto aligned with the drafter flag, not as new slip exposure.

votes.reasoning: The under 1.5 assists rests on a large recent sample (one game at 2+ in 12) and a finish-heavy role that DET’s missing creators do not obviously change. Blowout risk mainly trims minutes, which helps rather than hurts this under. Cross-book morning devig and lack of a fresh 2-book recheck weaken price support but not the volume thesis. I would cut if Collins’ on-ball usage or assist rate spikes materially in the last week.

Palmieri’s 2+ SOG rate in 10 of 12 and regular top-nine/PPTOU usage support over 1.5 despite a recent zero. Pageau GTD is more likely to elevate Palmieri’s lane than suppress shots. The FanDuel-only, ~15h-old quote is a pricing weakness, not a line/settlement mismatch. I would cut if Pageau plays and Palmieri is explicitly dropped from PP or a second line.

Jones’ season shooting volume (~2.4 SOG) and heavy minutes fit an over 1.5 in a high-total game with FLA missing key forwards, pushing more offense through defense. Recent 6/10 at 2+ is noisier than season but not contradictory. Cross-book devig and occasional 0-SOG games are the main drag. I would cut if his SOG trend drops over the last two weeks while TOI stays flat.

Cozens profiles as a low-volume shooter (season ~2.14 SOG) on a 5.5 total game, so under 2.5 is anchored in baseline rate rather than a blowout benching. Median recent games at 2 SOG supports the line. Thin cross-book hold and possible modest minute bump from OTT outs are real but already shaded. I would cut if he moves into a primary shot role or 3+ SOG becomes frequent in the last five games.

Season average well under 2.5 (1.76 SOG) and a playmaker profile favor the under despite top-line minutes. The last six include several exactly-3-SOG games, so settlement variance near the number is elevated. Stale single-book pricing adds skepticism but the pick is not spread-blowout-dependent. I would cut if Carlsson’s rolling SOG average clears ~2.5 over a longer window.

This leg fails the adopted 3PM under-1.5 ban: key rotation teammates have been out while his minutes and attempts (including 5, 2, 6 3PA last three) sit above the safe baseline, so the under is usage-exposed not purely low-volume. Single-book FanDuel is the only live quote, so the cited edge does not meet 2+ book discipline. Recheck does not remove those flags. I would keep only with multi-book confirmation and 3PA/minutes back in a clearly low-volume band without structural teammate outs.
